tools.name: get_meeting_recordings
tools.title: Get meeting recordings
tools.description: List the recordings of the video meeting behind a conference link (the url get_event_conference returns), newest first, among those the current user can open. For one occurrence of a recurring event, pass the occurrence's start as recorded_from and its end as recorded_to; leave both out for every recording of the series. Pass a recording's documentId as the document id of get_document_transcription_by_id to read its transcript. An empty list comes with a reason: NO_RECORDING (the meeting was not recorded, or its recording is not saved yet) or OTHER_PROVIDER (the link is not an eXo video meeting, e.g. Teams or Zoom).

conference_url.description: The meeting link, as get_event_conference returns it.

recorded_from.description: Optional. Earliest recording date: an RFC3339 date-time (2026-10-23T09:00:00Z) or a date yyyy-MM-dd (2026-10-23, the start of that day in UTC). Nothing else is accepted: resolve a relative expression such as 'yesterday' or 'last week' into such a date yourself.

recorded_to.description: Optional. End of the meeting or occurrence: an RFC3339 date-time (2026-10-23T10:00:00Z) or a date yyyy-MM-dd (2026-10-23, the end of that day in UTC); recordings saved shortly after it still count. Nothing else is accepted: resolve a relative expression such as 'yesterday' into such a date yourself.
